ticker_news.title: Powell Flags Sharp Tariff Shock, Elevated Uncertainty: Fed Sticks To  'Wait-And-See' Mode
ticker_news.description: Federal Reserve Chair Jerome Powell warned that tariff increases have introduced uncertainty into the U.S. economic outlook. The Fed is taking a 'wait-and-see' approach, as inflation above its 2% target limits its flexibility to cut rates as it did in 2019.
ticker_news.author: Piero Cingari

SPY.title: Fed Keeps Rates Steady, Warns Of Rising 'Uncertainty About The Economic Outlook'
SPY.description: The Federal Reserve kept interest rates steady at 4.25%-4.50% for the third consecutive meeting, but warned of increased uncertainty about the economic outlook, citing risks of higher unemployment and inflation.
SPY.author: Piero Cingari
